GuldanFelFlamePursuitOfFlame.name: Pursuit of Flame
GuldanFelFlamePursuitOfFlame.description: Quest: Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame without dying. Reward: Permanently increase Fel Flame's area by 33%.

GuldanChaoticEnergy.name: Chaotic Energy
GuldanChaoticEnergy.description: Increases the cast range of Drain Life by 25%, and Regen Globes heal for 50% more. Quest: Gather 15 Regen Globes. Reward: Basic Ability Mana costs are permanently reduced by 20.

GuldanCorruptionEchoedCorruption.name: Echoed Corruption
GuldanCorruptionEchoedCorruption.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Corruption. Reward: After hitting 40 heroes, Corruption gains new functionality. After the third strike, Corruption strikes 3 times in the opposite direction. Mythic Reward: After 85 hits, Corruption heals for 100% of the damage dealt.

GuldanDrainLifeHealthFunnel.name: Health Funnel
GuldanDrainLifeHealthFunnel.description: Drain Life's cooldown recharges 100% faster while it is channeling. If an enemy dies while under the effect of Drain Life, the cooldown is instantly refreshed.

GuldanLifeTapImprovedLifeTap.name: Improved Life Tap
GuldanLifeTapImprovedLifeTap.description: Increase the Mana restored by Life Tap to 40%.

GuldanConsumeSoul.name: Consume Soul
GuldanConsumeSoul.description: Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365 Health. Stores up to 3 charges.

GuldanFelFlameBoundByShadow.name: Bound by Shadow
GuldanFelFlameBoundByShadow.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

GuldanCorruptionCurseOfExhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
GuldanCorruptionCurseOfExhaustion.description: Drain Life deals 50% more damage and Slows the target's Movement Speed by 40%.

GuldanLifeTapHungerforPower.name: Hunger for Power
GuldanLifeTapHungerforPower.description: Increases Spell Power by 15% but reduces healing received from allies by 25%.

GuldanHorrify.name: Horrify
GuldanHorrify.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120 damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

GuldanRainOfDestruction.name: Rain of Destruction
GuldanRainOfDestruction.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165 damage in a small area.

GuldanFelFlameFelArmor.name: Fel Armor
GuldanFelFlameFelArmor.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

GuldanDrainLifeHarvestLife.name: Harvest Life
GuldanDrainLifeHarvestLife.description: Drain Life heals for 75% more Health when used on Heroes.

GuldanDarkBargain.name: Dark Bargain
GuldanDarkBargain.description: Gul'dan's maximum Health is permanently increased by 40% but his respawn time is increased by 10 seconds.

GuldanHealthstone.name: Healthstone
GuldanHealthstone.description: Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

GuldanFelFlameRampantHellfire.name: Rampant Hellfire
GuldanFelFlameRampantHellfire.description: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

GuldanCorruptionRuinousAffliction.name: Ruinous Affliction
GuldanCorruptionRuinousAffliction.description: Corruption deals an additional 70 damage on impact. If the enemy is hit by all three strikes, the third strike deals 242 damage.

GuldanLifeTapDarknessWithin.name: Darkness Within
GuldanLifeTapDarknessWithin.description: Dealing 600 damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Life Tap to cost no Health and grant Gul'dan 25% Spell Power for 5 seconds.

GuldanHorrifyHaunt.name: Haunt
GuldanHorrifyHaunt.description: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

GuldanRainOfDestructionDeepImpact.name: Deep Impact
GuldanRainOfDestructionDeepImpact.description: Rain of Destruction Slows enemies Movement Speed by 90% for 0.5 seconds.

GuldanDemonicCircle.name: Demonic Circle
GuldanDemonicCircle.description: Summon a Demonic Circle at Gul'dan's location. Activate to teleport Gul'dan to the Demonic Circle.
